sources.summary: Students at Finland's Aalto University have collaborated with Dutch pram brand Bugaboo to create a pushchair using bio-based and biodegradable materials. Amsterdam brand Bugaboo originally approached Aalto University during last year's Dutch Design Week, where the school presented an exhibition of experimental biomaterials.
